<title level="1" right="Action">[Act Together](/Actions.aspx?ID=4268) <actions string="Single Action to Three Actions" /></title>

<traits>
<trait label="Summoner" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=954" />
<trait label="Tandem" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=960" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 65

**Frequency** once per round

</column>

---

You and your eidolon act as one. Either you or your eidolon takes an action or activity using the same number of actions as Act Together, and the other takes a single action.

 For example, if you spent 2 actions to Act Together, you could cast [_breathe fire_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1457) (2 actions) and your eidolon could Strike (1 action), or your eidolon could use their Dragon Breath (2 actions) and you could Stride (1 action).

 This lets you each use separate [exploration activities](/Rules.aspx?ID=2442) like [Avoid Notice](/Actions.aspx?ID=2622) as you travel.
name: Act Together
